name: Jikkyou Douga de Yogosareta Ore no Tsuma ~Netorareta Hounyuu J Cup Tsuma Yukie
original_name: 実況動画で汚された俺の妻～寝取られた豊乳Ｊカップ妻 雪絵
source:
Yukie and Manabu were married 4 years. Manabu had made his way up the corporate ladder.
But he was being tempted by an overly forward teammate named Anzu. While Manabu was
distracted at work, another junior, Hajime, sets his sights on his beloved wife Yukie... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092729.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
雪絵和学已结婚四年。学在公司里步步高升。然而，他被一位过于主动的同事杏所诱惑。当学在工作中分心时，另一位后辈一瞄准了他心爱的妻子雪絵……
